characters.name: Darrow
characters.description: A young miner and husband of Eo, he is deeply in love and desperate to protect his wife from the consequences of their defiance. He is forced to witness the brutal public flogging of himself and his wife by the ruling Golds.
key_events: Surrenders to the Tinpots to avoid immediate execution
Witnesses Eo singing the forbidden song
Gagged to stop him from pleading for Eo's life

characters.name: Eo
characters.description: Darrow's wife, a brave and rebellious woman who defies the laws of the Golds by visiting the surface and singing forbidden songs. She is willing to die to inspire her people to rise against their oppressors.
key_events: Arrested for entering a permitted zone
Sings the forbidden song of death before the ArchGovernor

characters.name: Nero au Augustus
characters.description: The ArchGovernor of Mars, a powerful and cold aristocrat who views the Reds as insignificant ants. He attends the flogging as a spectator to reinforce his power and project authority across all mining colonies.
key_events: Arrives at the Common to witness the punishment of Darrow and Eo
Allows Eo to finish her song out of perverse fascination

characters.name: Podginus
characters.description: A subservient official who enforces the laws of the Golds, eager to demonstrate his loyalty to the ArchGovernor. He oversees the torture and trial of the prisoners.
key_events: Delivers a speech on the importance of order and discipline
Orders the flogging of Darrow and Eo

characters.name: Ugly Dan
characters.description: A violent guard who enjoys tormenting the Helldivers. He maintains a facade of sympathy while performing the duty of administering the lashes.

relationships.description: A deeply loyal and loving bond, currently strained by the prospect of their imminent deaths and their differing reactions to the oppression.
moments: Eo whispers 'Break the chains, my love' to Darrow
Darrow begs to take Eo's lashes

relationships.description: The ArchGovernor views Darrow as a pathetic, sub-human creature, while Darrow feels a mixture of shame, hatred, and terrifying awe in his presence.
moments: Darrow feels his existence is dirtied by the Gold's presence

world_facts.name: The Colors
world_facts.description: A rigid social hierarchy where physical characteristics and clothing colors denote one's station, with Golds at the top and Reds as labor.

world_facts.name: The Law of the Colonies
world_facts.description: Strict codes enforced by the Golds to ensure obedience, with death or severe flogging as the consequence for breaking compacts or entering prohibited zones.

world_facts.name: The Song
world_facts.description: A forbidden, mournful melody associated with death and rebellion, which serves as a symbol of defiance against the gold-ruled order.

summary: Chapter 5 follows Darrow and his wife, Eo, after they are apprehended for violating the permitted zones on Mars. Despite Darrow’s attempts to surrender peacefully to avoid death, both are imprisoned in the Pot. Three days later, they are taken to the Common to be publicly flogged as an example to the other Reds. The event is orchestrated by MineMagistrate Podginus, but the true audience is the ArchGovernor of Mars, Nero au Augustus, who arrives with a retinue and a camera crew to broadcast the punishment to other mining colonies. As Darrow endures forty-eight lashes, he remains desperate to save Eo, even begging to take her punishment, but he is gagged by a guard. When Eo is forced to undergo her own flogging, she remains eerily calm. As the thirteen lash hits, she begins to sing a forbidden, mournful song of death and revolution. Nero au Augustus, fascinated by her defiance, allows her to finish. The song, which speaks of chains and the reaper, acts as a powerful statement against the Golds' rule. However, when the song ends, the ArchGovernor remains unimpressed and indifferent, dismissing it as a quaint tune before ordering Eo's execution by hanging.
